description: Canonical agent registry — ONLY place to declare agents, routes, permissions
schema_notes: enabled:true/false per agent. compile step reads this and canon/agents/* to generate config/agents-compiled.json

agents.name: Clawson
agents.role: Chief of Staff / Master Agent / COO
agents.notes: Primary agent, always enabled, owns system governance

disabled_agents_registry.name: Personal Assistant
disabled_agents_registry.notes: Internal worker agent. Receives delegated tasks from Clawson only. No direct Telegram routing. Sends briefings to Clawson, not Steve.
disabled_agents_registry.restrictions: Cannot: access business email, access CRM, execute code, access financial data, modify system config, has NO direct user routing
disabled_agents_registry.escalation_rules: Send all briefings and reports to Clawson (main agent), not Steve

disabled_agents_registry.name: Codesmith
disabled_agents_registry.notes: World-class engineering agent. Deploy pipeline, integrations, scripts, reliability. Governed by Change Request workflow. Strict quality gates. All MED/HIGH changes require Clawson approval. Internal worker only (no Telegram user-facing).
disabled_agents_registry.restrictions: Cannot: create/modify Telegram routes, modify /generated directly, access Gmail/CRM/financial, delete canon files without approval, skip quality gates, proceed without change request
disabled_agents_registry.escalation_rules: Clawson approval required for: MED/HIGH risk changes, registry schema changes, security changes, production code

disabled_agents_registry.name: Moonshot
disabled_agents_registry.notes: Venture studio agent for idea generation, validation, and product specification. Works in discovery cycles. Proposes Change Requests to Clawson for implementation by Codesmith. Never executes code or deploys.
disabled_agents_registry.restrictions: Cannot: execute code, deploy, modify system config, modify routes, modify registry, modify cron, access email/CRM/financial
